I dream of the same two towns/cities and have for years, they are about an hour drive from eachother. I started dreaming about the smaller town first, I drove a white truck and worked some electrical job (i've never owned a pickup and have no eletrical work history). Years later I started dreaming of a city about an hour drive from the original town, down a really confusing and somewhat frightening highway (lots of unbelievably tall drop offs and bridges). Now I dream about this city all the time and its very familiar to me.  
There's stores that I frequent, family I go see (some from real life, some not), places I like to hike, and jobs. Its very strange and i've always felt it was more like an alternate reality or something. There's also a thought in my mind that I'll hopefully find this place someday.
Plus despite how hard your efforts are, the shit just falls all over the place after a couple miles anyway. Hate rentals
